	A1 --> B1
	A2 --> B2
	A3 --> B3
	A4 --> B4
	A5 --> B5
	A6 --> B6

	style Meadow Style fill:#f5f0e8,stroke:#423D37
	style oracledb Native fill:#e8f4f8,stroke:#2E7D74
","style":"notebook"}
